surf_model.breaking_method: PRELIMINARY: linear shoaling + Snell refraction; Hbreak=gamma*depth
surf_model.reference_status: Merrifield et al. 2004 formula NOT verified or implemented
surf_model.limitations: No measured nearshore bathymetry, sheltering, reef effects, tides or separate swell partitions. Do not use for safety decisions.
surf_model.wave_direction_convention: FROM (nautical/meteorological); native Copernicus IBI CF-decoded direction (no rotation)
surf_model.wave_energy: Offshore mean energy density rho*g*Hs^2/16 in kJ/m2
surf_model.wave_power: Approximate deepwater power in kW/m; Te assumed 0.9*Tp
surf_model.wind_criteria: PROVISIONAL continuous wind quality, 256 deg is onshore; 76 deg is offshore; Glassy takes priority over Offshore breeze; offshore breeze from 105 deg deviation
surf_model.wind_threshold_interpolation: piecewise linear at 0, 90, 135 and 180 deg; equal 135/180 deg thresholds give a full-offshore plateau
surf_model.weather_note: tcc in percent; ECMWF tprate converted to mm/h; rain_mm_interval approximates preceding time interval; intense rain icon does not assert thunder
surf_model.temperature_note: IFS 2t is 2-m air temperature. IFS skt is a surface skin temperature; over verified sea grid points only, it is an SST proxy, not a dedicated ocean temperature forecast.

tide.datum: TPXO9 model-relative level (not nautical chart datum)
